h:
用于 ComfyUI 的简单 Wan 2.2 I2V，可正确处理高噪声和低噪声模型的步骤。 Wan 2.2 经过训练，可以在生成过程中的非常特定的点从高切换到低，从而影响输出。此工作流程处理正确的时间。

该工作流程要求您手动安装此节点脚本：https://github.com/stduhpf/ComfyUI-WanMoeKSampler

WanMoeKSampler的作者有错误的安装说明。正确的命令是

git 克隆 https://github.com/stduhpf/ComfyUI-WanMoeKSampler

您可能需要为此工作流程安装其他模型。

此 ComfyUI 工作流程自 2025 年 8 月 24 日起生效

o.en:
A simple Wan 2.2 I2V for ComfyUI that handles the steps correctly for the High and Low noise models. Wan 2.2 was trained to switch over from high to low at very specific points during generation that impacts the output. This workflow handles the correct timing.

The workflow requires you to manually install this node script:https://github.com/stduhpf/ComfyUI-WanMoeKSampler

The author of WanMoeKSampler has the wrong installation instructions. The correct command is

git clone https://github.com/stduhpf/ComfyUI-WanMoeKSampler

You may need to install other models for this workflow.

This ComfyUI workflow works as of 8/24/2025
